result.description:
Metal Fabricator-Tottenham Vic

Kogan People Solutions are working with an ISO 9001:2015 Certified trailer manufacturer based in Tottenham, Victoria. They specialize heavily in custom-built top tier single axle, tandem and custom built trailers tailored to specific trade, commercial, or landscaping needs. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for completing high quality metal fabrication work utilised in the production of these trailers. You will attend to all tasks safely and effectively, applying knowledge of materials, fabrication techniques and relevant industry standards. 

•	Location – Tottenham, VIC

•	Tenure – Full time and ongoing

•	Salary – negotiable in the range $78k to $85k plus superannuation per annum

Responsibilities Include:

•	Interpret technical engineering plans, blueprints and other fabrication drawings

•	Select, prepare, assemble and finish high quality metal components 

•	Set up and skilfully use MIG, TIG and Stick welding techniques according to project requirements 

•	Operate heat and thermal cutting equipment safely and effectively 

•	Operate workshop machinery and fabrication tools relevant to trailer manufacturing 

•	Assemble, tack and fit components to form trailer structures and frames

About you:

You have a passion for the metalworking industry and are up to date on the latest industrial and safety techniques. Your work history shows you demonstrate an unwavering commitment to welding of the highest quality, whilst working within a cohesive and hardworking team environment.

To succeed in this role, you:
•	Possess a relevant Certificate IV in a highly relevant field of study or an agreed equivalent 

•	Have 3 or more years of trade / professional experience working in similar roles

•	Have great attention to detail, high quality of work and proven experience in the welding field.

•	Are able to skilfully read and interpret blueprints and fabrication drawings

•	Work with a high level of safety awareness at all times

•	Are capable of undertaking physical labour, including safe use of workshop equipment (such as overhead cranes)

•	Are experienced in MIG, TIG and Stick welding techniques.

•	Offer proven ability to prioritise, set goals and have the determination to achieve them.

•	Enjoy working in and around cohesive teams and follow instructions.

•	Be very safety conscious, comfortable always using PPE.

You must have unrestricted full time Australian working rights to be considered.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

result.description:
Accountant
Location: Parramatta, Sydney NSW
Industry: Business Services & Corporate Advisory (Accounting)
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum + Superannuation

About the Employer
Tax Solutions New South Wales is a growing boutique accounting and advisory firm based in Parramatta. Since 2021, we have delivered high-quality, client-focused solutions across a wide range of accounting disciplines. We support small to medium-sized businesses and individuals with bookkeeping, taxation, business advisory, cash flow forecasting, and external CFO services. Our firm prides itself on accuracy, responsiveness, and personal service.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Accountant to join our professional team and contribute to delivering expert financial guidance and compliance solutions to our expanding client base.

Key Responsibilities
•	Preparation and lodgment of income tax returns, Business Activity Statements (BAS), and financial statements for individuals, partnerships, companies, and trusts
•	Assisting with tax planning strategies, including GST, CGT, FBT, and Division 7A compliance
•	Conducting bank reconciliations, payroll processing, accounts payable/receivable reviews, and end-of-month journals
•	Liaising directly with clients to provide clear, practical advice and resolve technical queries
•	Supporting the firm’s Principal with documentation and insights for management reporting and client briefings
•	Assisting with external CFO support, including forecasting, budgeting, and financial performance analysis
•	Collaborating with administrative staff and junior team members to ensure timely preparation and submission of financial documentation
•	Ensuring accuracy and compliance with Australian Accounting Standards and ATO regulations

Skills & Qualifications
The ideal candidate will possess:
•	A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related discipline
•	A minimum of 1–2 years’ experience in public practice accounting in Australia (essential)
•	Sound knowledge of Australian taxation law, GST, and relevant reporting frameworks
•	Demonstrated experience using accounting software platforms (e.g., Xero, MYOB, or QuickBooks)
•	Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to interpret financial data
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a proactive, client-focused attitude
•	Ability to manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, and work both independently and within a small team
•	Intention to pursue or current enrolment in CPA or CA qualification (desirable but not mandatory)

What We Offer
•	Structured training and mentorship from senior professionals
•	Financial and study support for CPA/CA progression
•	A variety of engagements across multiple industries and business structures
•	A flexible working environment including access to the latest accounting tools and systems
•	A friendly, inclusive culture that values collaboration, professional growth, and employee wellbeing
•	Long-term career development with opportunities for progression within the firm

Application Process
This position is open to Australian citizens, permanent residents, and visa holders with full work rights. 
Applications close: 13th August 2026
How to Apply: Please submit your CV and a cover letter addressing the key selection criteria via the Apply button.
For inquiries, contact: m.ashraf@taxsolutions.net.au

TAX SOLUTIONS NEW SOUTH WALES is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and celebrate equal opportunity employment.

You also get the added bonus that what you do will make a difference in the community.

Our clients are some of Australia’s biggest and strong demand will ensure long-term employment.
We believe in Creating Opportunity and any profits we create do exactly that for those who need a little bit of extra support.

Joii provides hope and opportunity for disadvantaged and vulnerable people. Joii's approach is twofold:
•	We provide social impact programs that offer hope and opportunity for the disadvantaged and vulnerable. The programs focus on providing employment, pathways to employment, and housing opportunities.
•	We operate sustainable funding creating social enterprises whose objective is to support the vision.

The Opportunity:
Joii offers secure, well-paid positions with the added bonus that what you do will make a difference in our community. 

Due to a long, strong, and ongoing pipeline of work we are ungently seeking enthusiastic and motivated applicants for the positions of qualified Motor Mechanic within our Queensland Trades Team who will work for our valued clients.  You will be working from either Joii Limited Brisbane office or Joii Limited regional office Deebing Heights QLD.

Essential skills needed:
•	Qualification as a Diesel Mechanic
•	Expertise knowledge of current heavy vehicle maintenance requirements.
•	Be able to read and interpret technical manuals.
•	Hold all industry required tickets and tools.
•	Supply & maintain own commercial grade tools, noting a tool maintenance allowance is included in the salary package) 
•	Provide own vehicle to get themselves and their tools to site. 
•	Maintain current driver’s license.

About You:
•	Able to work unsupervised and part of a team.
•	Able to follow instructions.
•	Hard working and reliable.
•	Attention to detail and able to work to deadlines.

What you need to do now
If you are interested and have the experience, we would love to hear from you!
Please click the 'APPLY' button now and send through your resume and cover letter detailing your previous relevant experience and why you are the perfect candidate for our team.

Please note, due to the high number of applications we expect to receive, we will only be responding to applicants who have been successful in securing an interview.

Additional Information:
AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3)
The role includes repairing, maintaining and testing heavy vehicles and other diesel engines and related mechanical components of buses, trucks and heavy vehicles.

Tasks Include:
•	 detecting and diagnosing faults in engines and parts
•	dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and checking parts
•	diagnosing and testing with the assistance of computers
•	repairing and replacing worn and defective parts and reassembling mechanical components, and referring to service manuals as needed 
•	order parts and maintain Inventories.
•	performing scheduled maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups, to achieve smoother running of vehicles and ensure compliance with regulations.
•	rebuilding engines and parts after being repaired.
•	welding and painting of vehicles and components 
•	may inspect vehicles and issue roadworthiness certificates or detail work required to achieve roadworthiness.
